proven_findings.evidence: The routine obtains the current player/session record through 0x004320D9, performs state gates and room/action interception, and delegates general command execution to 0x0046B010. It is an active gameplay command gateway, not the terminal tokenizer.
Imported/current input text pointer is repeatedly compared, prefixed, formatted, and passed to command/speech executors.
Scans up to ten room action slots; type 0x0A matches three 82-byte aliases at record offsets +0x04,+0x56,+0xA8; type 0x0C performs the same alias matching then optional requirement/effect execution.
Called with room/source pair, session id, -1,0,1,1,255 and returns a handled bit accumulated across current room and up to ten room-linked records.

Two configured single-byte command prefixes route to say/yell formatting. Slash is also admitted on one branch. Local say uses current room coordinates; yell broadcasts through current room and linked directions.
Emitted only when no special state path and no general executor call reports handling.
Most consumed paths return 1. Failure to acquire the current player/session record emits an error and returns 0.
